name: splunk_create_dashboard
title: Dashboard Creation Capability
description: Creates a new dashboard in the custom_app app. Accepts Simple XML (version="1.1") or Dashboard Studio (version="2" with a <definition> CDATA block). Fails if a dashboard with that ID already exists; to change an existing dashboard use splunk_update_dashboard.

dashboard_name.description: Dashboard ID (letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens only; becomes the URL name)

eai_data.description: Complete dashboard source (Simple XML or Dashboard Studio), starting with <dashboard> and containing a <label> element.

examples.name: Create a simple dashboard
examples.expected_use: When a user asks to create a new Splunk dashboard
